rationale: Linkage and whole-genome sequencing studies in multiplex families (Zhou et al., 2023) identified segregating KDM6B missense variants linked to co-occurring ASD and ADHD, and rodent models of Kdm6b deficiency demonstrate core ASD/ADHD behavioral phenotypes (Gao et al., 2022). However, systematic clinical ascertainment in cohorts with de novo KDM6B missense and truncating variants (Stolerman et al., 2019; Rots et al., 2023) demonstrates that pathogenic missense variants—including those outside the catalytic domain—consistently present with multi-system features including developmental delay/intellectual disability, coarse facial features, and mild skeletal abnormalities rather than isolated non-syndromic psychiatric presentations.

evidence.text: In the New Jersey Language and Autism Genetics Study of multiplex families with co-occurring ASD and ADHD, KDM6B was prioritized as the highest-ranking candidate gene within linkage regions, harboring two missense variants segregating in two families.

evidence.text: Detailed clinical delineation of KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM #618505) confirmed that individuals carrying pathogenic missense and truncating variants display coarse facies, cognitive impairment, and mild distal skeletal abnormalities rather than isolated psychiatric disorders.

conflicts: Familial linkage studies show missense variants segregating with isolated/co-occurring ASD and ADHD without reported syndromic dysmorphology, whereas comprehensive clinical cohorts identify significant physical stigmata (coarse facies, skeletal defects) across individuals with de novo missense variants.

It remains unresolved whether segregating non-catalytic missense variants represent fully penetrant hypomorphic monogenic alleles or modest-effect polygenic risk variants within complex ASD/ADHD architecture.

new_directions.question_text: Do non-JmjC missense variants identified in non-syndromic ADHD/ASD cohorts exhibit partial residual histone demethylase activity or impaired non-enzymatic protein-protein interactions compared to catalytic JmjC domain mutations?
new_directions.rationale: Clarifying whether non-catalytic domain variants function as hypomorphic alleles or benign passenger variants in ASD/ADHD requires quantitative in vitro H3K27me3 demethylation and interactome profiling assays.

new_directions.question_text: What is the penetrance of craniofacial and digital anomalies in unselected carriers of non-catalytic KDM6B missense variants identified in population cohorts (e.g., UK Biobank or gnomAD)?
